video_title: POSTGAME SOUND: ORLANDO MAGIC VS. WASHINGTON WIZARDS | COACH SWEENEY & TRISTAN DA SILVA

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney on the Wizards' offensive performance and defensive lapses
quotes.excerpt: I think they shot 52 from the floor, 56 from three, they got to the line 20 times
quotes.quote: I think they shot 52 from the floor, 56 from three, they got to the line 20 times to bounce ahead. I think 11 free throws or so. Davis was really good, Keonte George was really good. Had a tough time keeping them out of transition, got to do a better job there. Thought their length bothered us on the other end, had a tough time. We did get in the paint, making the decisions we needed to from start to finish, they did a great job.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney on the Magic defensive struggles against Washington: We had a tough time keeping them out of transition and got to do a better job there. They shot 56 percent from three and we have to be better.

structured.context: Coach Sweeney discusses the defensive struggles of the Magic against the Wizards and individual performances by opposing players.

quotes.speaker: Coach Sweeney
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Sweeney criticizes team shot selection and ball movement
quotes.excerpt: We definitely took some tough ones. I thought the ball stuck for a little bit there.
quotes.quote: We definitely took some tough ones. I thought the ball stuck for a little bit there. Didn't have the same ball movement that we would hope to, but sometimes that happens. Got to be better. In general with some of those guys that are good shooters like George, we got to do a better job. A guy like that can't get 11 threes up.
quotes.social_post: Coach Sweeney says the ball stuck too much for the Magic tonight. He noted the team failed to limit the Wizards shooters, specifically saying a guy like George cannot get 11 threes up.

structured.context: Coach Sweeney critiques his team's ball movement and defensive effort against opposing shooters.

quotes.speaker: Tristan da Silva
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan da Silva on defensive lapses and allowing easy buckets
quotes.excerpt: I think we we let them get going early. They saw a couple easy ones going in.
quotes.quote: I think we let them get going early. They saw a couple easy ones going in. I think beginning of the game, we took a couple early shots that that let them run out and get easy buckets and get their guys going and obviously the way the way they shot it from three, we weren't really impacting that too much.
quotes.social_post: Tristan da Silva says the Magic allowed the Wizards to get going early by taking questionable shots that led to easy transition buckets for Washington.

structured.context: Tristan da Silva explains how early offensive mistakes allowed the Wizards to find a rhythm in transition.

quotes.speaker: Tristan da Silva
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan da Silva on poor defensive execution and shot quality
quotes.excerpt: Didn't really have to work too much on defense.
quotes.quote: There was a couple tough ones. Like I said, a couple early ones that were questionable and let them get going. Didn't really have to work too much on defense. There's a lot of guys that we want to put in actions on the other side and I don't think we did a great job of that. Let them off the hook a little bit.
quotes.social_post: Tristan da Silva on the Magic defensive effort: We let them off the hook a little bit. We did not do a great job of putting their guys in actions on the other side of the floor.

structured.context: Tristan da Silva reflects on the team's poor defensive execution and failure to challenge the Wizards effectively.

quotes.speaker: Tristan da Silva
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan da Silva on the need for better fundamentals and execution
quotes.excerpt: Making simple plays, getting off the ball when when you see two, getting off the ball when you see a crowd.
quotes.quote: Making simple plays, getting off the ball when when you see two, getting off the ball when you see a crowd. Shooting the open shots that we get and and and executing. I think screening well, having good spacing and knowing who's on the floor, knowing who to put in the actions and executing based off of that.
quotes.social_post: Tristan da Silva on what the Magic need to improve: Making simple plays, getting off the ball when you see a crowd, screening well and having good spacing.

structured.context: Tristan da Silva outlines the fundamental improvements needed for the Magic to execute better on the offensive end.
